blocks.text: Model the training run, metrics, and logs so the UI can render a stable dashboard.

TrainingRun owns lifecycle with its latest accepted sequence. MetricPoint and LogEvent retain event identity and sequence. MonitorState keeps the last contiguous sequence, opaque resume cursor, freshness, and unresolved gap.

State-model checks:
- Clear metric point structure.
- Bounded log storage.
- Status and progress fields.
- Cursors or sequence ids for resume.

blocks.title: State checkpoint
blocks.text: A good data model makes realtime updates predictable: small metric points, bounded logs, and a cursor for resume.
Run lifecycle, sequence, metric, and log ownership

Separate RunSummary lifecycle from MetricSeries samples, EventCursor, ChartViewWindow, and ComparisonSelection. Metric buffers preserve timestamp, step, value, and sequence. Derived summaries include latest accepted value, range, freshness, and gap state. Large histories are fetched or downsampled by visible range rather than copied into every component.
